meta.purpose: Правила работы с PostgreSQL и Prisma ORM в TripVibe. LLM MUST следовать при создании схем, миграций, queries и seed data.

rule.title: Prisma as single source of truth
rule.description: schema.prisma — единственный источник схемы БД. Все изменения через prisma migrate dev. Ручной SQL — только для performance indexes с документированием.

rule.title: UUID primary keys
rule.description: Все модели используют id String @id @default(cuid()) или uuid(). Auto-increment integer IDs — запрещены (проблемы при merge seed/migration).

rule.title: Timestamps on all entities
rule.description: Каждая модель MUST иметь createdAt DateTime @default(now()). Mutable entities — updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt.

rule.title: Soft enums via Prisma enum
rule.description: Ограниченные значения — Prisma enum, не free string: PropertyType (APARTMENT, HOUSE, ROOM), BookingStatus (PENDING, CONFIRMED, COMPLETED, CANCELLED).

rule.title: Denormalization for read performance
rule.description: Listing.averageRating и Listing.reviewCount — denormalized, обновляются при create/delete Review. Не пересчитывать AVG() на каждый search query.

model.name: User
model.fields: id, email @unique, name, avatarUrl?, passwordHash?, createdAt, updatedAt

model.name: Listing
model.fields: id, title, description @db.Text, city, country, lat Float, lng Float, pricePerNight Int (копейки/центы — хранить в минимальных единицах), cleaningFee Int, serviceFee Int, propertyType PropertyType, amenities String[] (e.g. ["wifi", "kitchen", "parking"]), images String[] (URLs), hostId → User, averageRating Float @default(0), reviewCount Int @default(0)

model.name: Booking
model.fields: id, userId → User, listingId → Listing, checkIn DateTime @db.Date, checkOut DateTime @db.Date, guests Int, totalPrice Int, status BookingStatus @default(PENDING)
model.constraints: checkOut MUST be > checkIn. Unique review per booking (Review.bookingId @unique).

model.name: Favorite
model.fields: id, userId → User, listingId → Listing, createdAt

model.name: Review
model.fields: id, userId → User, listingId → Listing, bookingId → Booking @unique, rating Int (1-5), text @db.Text, photos String[], createdAt

model.name: Location
model.fields: id, name, type LocationType (CITY, COUNTRY), slug @unique, lat Float?, lng Float?

rule.title: Single Prisma client instance
rule.description: Import prisma from '@/lib/prisma'. Singleton pattern с globalThis guard для dev hot reload. НЕ создавать new PrismaClient() в route handlers или components.

rule.title: Select only needed fields
rule.description: Search/list endpoints MUST use select или include с конкретными полями. Запрещён findMany без select на Listing (description — тяжёлое поле, не нужно в search).

rule.title: Transactions for multi-table writes
rule.description: createBooking + availability check, submitReview + update averageRating — prisma.$transaction(). Rollback при любой ошибке.

rule.title: Availability overlap check
rule.description: Перед созданием Booking MUST проверить отсутствие пересечения дат: existing.checkIn < new.checkOut AND existing.checkOut > new.checkIn для status IN (CONFIRMED, PENDING) на том же listingId.

rule.title: Pagination required for lists
rule.description: search, reviews, trips — cursor-based или offset pagination. Default limit: 20. Max limit: 50. Return meta: { total, page, hasMore }.

rule.title: Search filters as Prisma where
rule.description: priceMin/priceMax → pricePerNight gte/lte. propertyType → equals enum. amenities → hasEvery or hasSome depending on UX (AND vs OR — document in code). city → equals or contains (case-insensitive via mode: 'insensitive').

rule.title: Store prices in minor units
rule.description: pricePerNight, cleaningFee, serviceFee, totalPrice — Int (копейки/центы). Display: formatPrice(cents) → "3 500 ₽". Calculation in integers to avoid float errors.

rule.title: Server-side price verification
rule.description: API MUST пересчитать totalPrice на сервере при createBooking. Client-sent totalPrice — игнорировать или сверять (reject if mismatch > 0).

rule.title: Descriptive migration names
rule.description: prisma migrate dev --name add_review_photos. Не auto-generated без rename.

rule.title: Seed idempotency
rule.description: prisma/seed.ts MUST быть идемпотентным (upsert, не create-only). Минимум: 3 cities, 20 listings, 5 users, 10 bookings (mixed statuses).

rule.title: No breaking changes without migration path
rule.description: Rename column → @map или multi-step migration (add new, migrate data, drop old). Не менять enum values без data migration.

rule.title: Module ownership of models
rule.description: Изменение schema модели — PR от owner-модуля (см. semantic_graph.xml). Cross-model relation changes — согласование в Phase 0/2, PR с reviewers от обоих модулей.

rule.title: Repository pattern per module
rule.description: Каждый модуль имеет {module}.repository.ts с typed query functions. Route handlers вызывают repository, не inline prisma calls. Пример: searchListings(params), getListingById(id), createBooking(input).

rule.title: Auth-scoped queries
rule.description: getUserTrips(userId), getUserFavorites(userId) — MUST filter by authenticated userId. Никогда не принимать userId из client body без session verification.
